clue.text: Answer back right and left sound most unpleasant

indicators.note: back says the abbreviation for answer is turned round to run the other way

explanation.surface: Someone told to reply rudely, right and left, sounding as nasty as possible.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns the abbreviation for answer round; 'sound' is a noun in the definition, not a link meaning 'seem'.
explanation.definitionFit: A snarl is a growl with bared teeth, about the nastiest noise one can make.

clue.text: A cleaner having to rush round for extra money

indicators.note: round makes the word for rush go round the cleaner

parts.note: a surge is a sudden rush
a char is a British cleaning lady

explanation.surface: A cleaning lady dashes about for bonus pay.
explanation.walkthrough: CHAR (short for charwoman) is a British term for a cleaner.
explanation.definitionFit: A surcharge is an additional fee added to a price.

clue.text: A service being set up in India

indicators.note: set up in a down clue means the word is turned to read upwards

parts.note: mass is a church service

explanation.surface: A church service arranged in India.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being set up' reverses MASS to SSAM in the down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Assam is a state in the northeast of India, famous for tea.

clue.text: Comes down on idle characters making a bad slip

parts.note: lands means comes down to earth

indicators.note: making these characters into something new means the letters of idle are rearranged

explanation.surface: Lazy people fall into a serious error.
explanation.walkthrough: 'idle characters' means the letters of idle, which 'making' rearranges; 'Comes down' is landing, not a fall.
explanation.definitionFit: A landslide is a collapse of earth down a slope, a disastrous slip.

clue.text: Quietly staying, being in control of the situation

definitions.text: being in control of the situation

parts.note: P is piano, the musical marking for quietly
residing means living or staying somewhere

explanation.surface: A calm guest who stays put and keeps everything under control.
explanation.definitionFit: To preside is to chair a meeting, holding authority over proceedings.

clue.text: The point in Apache dancing is swagger

indicators.note: dancing letters jig about into a new order

parts.note: N, north, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: The whole point of Apache dancing is flamboyant confidence.
explanation.definitionFit: Panache is flamboyant style and confidence.

clue.text: For the viewers this is a wash-out!

definitions.text: For the viewers this is a wash-out!

parts.words: For the viewers this is a wash-out!
parts.note: the viewers are eyes, and a wash-out here is literally something for rinsing them, not a failure

explanation.surface: A TV show flopped with its audience.
explanation.definitionFit: An eye bath is a small cup for bathing the eye.

clue.text: A model thought to be over fifty

indicators.note: in a down clue, being over means sitting above the next piece

parts.note: an idea is a thought
L is the Roman numeral fifty

explanation.surface: A fashion model believed to be past fifty.
explanation.definitionFit: An ideal is a perfect example to follow.

clue.text: In a series of exercises the head displays incompetence

parts.note: taken as written
PT is physical training
a ness is a headland

explanation.surface: A head teacher's exercise sessions reveal ineptitude.
explanation.walkthrough: NESS is a headland, as in Loch Ness's shores; 'displays' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Inaptness is unsuitability or lack of skill.

clue.text: Goes potty about duck and other poultry

indicators.note: about puts the scrambled letters round the zero
potty means crazy, so the letters go crazy

parts.note: a duck is zero in cricket, the letter O

explanation.surface: Someone goes mad over ducks and other fowl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'potty' rearranges GOES into GOSE; 'about' puts it round O.
explanation.definitionFit: A goose is a farmyard bird, poultry besides duck.

clue.text: The manufacture of non-crease material resulting in boom

indicators.note: manufacturing turns raw stuff into something new, so the letters of the following word are remade

explanation.surface: Making crease-resistant cloth leads to a business boom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'material resulting in' is link padding; 'boom' is a deep echoing sound, not an economic upturn.
explanation.definitionFit: Resonance is a deep, sustained reverberating sound, like a boom.

clue.text: Muse, but get too disheartened after a time

indicators.note: after puts the shortened word behind the period of time

parts.note: an era is a period of time

indicators.note: losing its heart means the middle letter of the word too is dropped

explanation.surface: A creative spark, though one gets too discouraged after a while.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disheartened' removes the heart of too; 'Muse' is the definition, not a verb meaning ponder.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Erato is one of the nine Muses, presiding over love poetry.

clue.text: Does some gardening work around many residences

indicators.note: around has the gardening verb surround the letter for many

parts.note: hoes means works the soil with a hoe
M, the Roman numeral for a thousand, stands for many

explanation.surface: A gardener tends plots around a number of houses.
explanation.definitionFit: Homes are dwellings, places where people reside.

clue.text: Woman getting the church to alter drastically

parts.note: CH is the usual abbreviation for church

indicators.note: altering something drastically changes it out of recognition, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A woman makes the church change radically.
explanation.definitionFit: Charlotte is a woman's first name.

clue.text: Note animosity can lead to a break

parts.note: re is the second note of the sol-fa scale
spite is ill will or animosity

explanation.surface: Ill feeling can end in a falling-out or rupture.
explanation.definitionFit: A respite is a pause or interval of relief.

clue.text: Lacking ambition, don't move home so often

explanation.surface: Lazy folk stay put.
explanation.definitionFit: Shiftless means lazy and unmotivated; read as shift less, it means relocate less often.

clue.text: The press holds a weighty weapon!

indicators.note: holds has the crowd contain the other pieces

parts.note: a press is a dense crowd, a herd
LB, the abbreviation for pound, is a unit of weight

explanation.surface: The newspapers are carrying a heavy armament story.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The press' looks like the newspapers but is a crushing crowd, HERD, holding A and LB.
explanation.definitionFit: A halberd is a medieval pole arm combining spear and axe.

clue.text: Count the cash — and put on an accent!

parts.note: L, for pound sterling, stands for cash
a grave is an accent mark on a letter

explanation.surface: Tot up the money and adopt a posh voice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Count' is the noun, a nobleman, not the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A landgrave was a German count with territorial jurisdiction.

clue.text: Saw reforms rescinded

indicators.note: reforms means forms again, so the letters take a new shape

explanation.surface: Watched as changes were cancelled.
explanation.definitionFit: To discern is to perceive or see.

clue.text: Getting some of them in entails standing out

indicators.note: getting only some of the following words means the letters lie within them

explanation.surface: Including some of those people involves being prominent.
explanation.definitionFit: Eminent describes someone distinguished, conspicuous above others.

clue.text: A hard drinker, though a high-flier

explanation.surface: A heavy drinker yet an achiever.
explanation.definitionFit: A tippler is a habitual drinker, and also a breed of pigeon that flies high for long periods.

clue.text: Information is available about French art for a start

parts.note: gen is British slang for information
es is French for art, as in thou art

explanation.surface: Facts are available on French painting for beginners.
explanation.walkthrough: 'art' is the old verb (thou art), French es; 'available about' is linking padding.
explanation.definitionFit: Genesis means an origin or beginning.

clue.text: Action gets results on the river

indicators.note: results means what comes out of change, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the Ure is a river in Yorkshire

explanation.surface: Doing something gets outcomes by the water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'results' rearranges GETS into GEST; the Ure is a Yorkshire river.
explanation.definitionFit: A gesture is a movement or act expressing feeling.

clue.text: A worker runs off when such beasts appear

parts.note: an ant is the classic worker in crosswords
elopes means runs away secretly to marry

explanation.surface: A labourer flees when wild animals show up.
explanation.definitionFit: Antelopes are grazing horned mammals of Africa and Asia.

clue.text: Confer when making a tie-up

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word for tie reads upwards

parts.note: a draw is a tied game

explanation.surface: Bestow something on striking a bond.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses DRAW to WARD under A.
explanation.definitionFit: To award is to grant or bestow formally.

clue.text: The French department has to join in this game

parts.note: Lot is a department of southwest France
taken as written

explanation.surface: A French region must sign up for the game.
explanation.definitionFit: Lotto is a game of chance drawing numbers.

clue.text: Jar for the fireplace

explanation.surface: A pot meant for the hearth.
explanation.definitionFit: To grate is to jar or irritate; a grate is the metal frame holding a fire in a hearth.

clue.text: An article to enjoy equally

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
to like is to enjoy

explanation.surface: A grammar item to savour in equal measure.
explanation.definitionFit: Alike as an adverb means in the same way.

clue.text: A fellow advocate

parts.note: gent is a man or fellow

explanation.surface: A man who argues on someone's behalf.
explanation.definitionFit: An agent acts for another person, as a representative does.

clue.text: At one over following an archbishop in praise

indicators.note: following places the remaining letters after the churchman's name

parts.note: William Laud was Archbishop of Canterbury under Charles I
taken as written
I is the Roman numeral one
on can mean over, as in a book on or over a topic

explanation.surface: Someone, after a cricket over, follows a senior cleric in giving thanks.
explanation.walkthrough: William Laud was Charles I's Archbishop of Canterbury; 'over' giving ON is the sense 'about', not a cricket over.
explanation.definitionFit: Laudation is formal commendation or acclaim.

clue.text: Old Nick by the way will make conversation

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld, so a name for the Devil, Old Nick
a course is a route or way

explanation.surface: The Devil, by the roadside, will strike up a chat.
explanation.definitionFit: Discourse is spoken exchange, talk between people.

clue.text: Correct editor taking people in

indicators.note: taking means the abbreviation for editor takes in the other piece

parts.note: men are people

explanation.surface: An accurate editor lets people in.
explanation.definitionFit: To emend is to correct a text by removing errors.
